response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile software craftsman with strong full-stack, systems, and open-source leadership experience, but he does not meet the core minimum qualifications for this role: his C++ experience is limited to a single ~6-month stint in 2014-2015, far short of the required 8 years, and his career has centered on web/product engineering (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) rather than large-scale cloud compute platform architecture. While he shows leadership, mentoring, and infrastructure exposure, the fundamental C++ and cloud-compute-platform experience gap makes him a poor fit for this specific technical lead role.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level experience (15+ years) across many domains and technologies
Demonstrated leadership through workshops, talks, and founding an open-source platform
Strong distributed systems/infrastructure exposure (Dunnhumby micro-services, DevOps/CI setup at Altom)
concerns: C++ experience is minimal (~6 months in 2014-2015), nowhere near the required 8 years
No direct experience with cloud compute platforms, hardware architecture, or compute/storage infrastructure at scale
Career trajectory is broad generalist/full-stack rather than focused technical leadership on infrastructure/cloud platforms

key_factors.factor: Lack of cloud compute platform/infrastructure specialization
Strong general leadership, mentoring, and distributed systems background
